provenance: New source translation; E3990-E3999 and E4080-E4089 reviewed.
context: Defeated fiends promise resurrection and torture. Party captures a pink Vorpal Bunny, retrieves Anselm's book from Riz, then finds Fiore unharmed.
decisions: Fiends' threats retain force. Riz female established elsewhere; source uses mage title. Deliberate interrupted clauses and row continuations preserved.

translations.en: Had the fairy driven off the monsters with that white light, then died doing it?

translations.en: @7rLady Marbas@0r was dead?
Had @7rLady Marbas@0r exhausted her magic with that burst of light
and died to protect you?
No matter. If the fairy is dead, I'll drag out that soul
and torment it until I tire of the sport.
Rather than fall into your "Prison of Souls,"
I'd sooner fall into the "Prison of the Old Ones"... hell itself.
Ha ha ha ha ha...
You're only humans, but shall I cast you down there together?
Keep each other company as my playthings in the Prison of Souls!
Gwaaaaagh!
I misjudged you! To think you were this strong!
Hee hee hee... Fine entertainment indeed.
So someone could take my life after all!
But let me tell you something!
We are mere lackeys! Even if you defeat us,
countless others are working to fulfill our deepest wish!
Ha ha ha ha... Precisely.
Defeating us cannot stop this seal from being broken!
The demon realm is destined to become this world!
Struggle all you like until that day of judgment comes!
We are eternal. In time, we shall regain our bodies
and return to kill you!
And it may not be a moonlit night when we do!
Live in fear of darkness and shadows! When that time comes,
we'll be waiting there to take your lives!
Heee hee hee hee! Heee hee hee hee...
We will return to kill you! You can be certain of that!
With those curses and eerie laughter,
@7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r turned to pitch-black smoke
and vanished...
After the smoke cleared, only silence remained.
If their words were true,
they might return someday.
And somewhere, other monsters might also be trying
to break the seal...
In any case, to pass on @7rLady Marbas's@0r words,
you should return to the inn.
True to its name, the @3rKigashira Mushroom@0r had a cap
shaped just like a tree stump.
It apparently wasn't poisonous to humans,
but its appearance did little to whet your appetite.
Just as you were about to take it back,
you sensed something like murderous intent behind you.
You turned slowly, and there...
was a bizarre creature with pink fur, looking for all the world
like a fluffy stuffed toy, but with a dangerous gleam in its eyes
as it stared straight at you.
You captured the pink Vorpal Bunny.
It seemed to have lost the will to fight,
but there was no telling when it might attack again.
You decided to put it in a sturdy leather sack
and carry it back.
In front of a ruined house, several mages had laid out antiques
they appeared to have recovered and were appraising them.
Oh... Hello. I'm @7rRiz@0r.
I'm a mage who makes a living as an adventurer.
Have you found anything interesting?
Apparently, this was the @7rRiz@0r you were looking for.
When you explained why you had come,
@7rRiz@0r seemed extremely surprised.
Riz
Oh, my goodness...
I borrowed it without realizing it was so important.
I'm terribly sorry...
You explained that @7rAnselm@0r needed it for research,
but perhaps she mistook that for some momentous investigation:
the mage was flustered beyond all reason.
Here, I'll return it to you.
You received @7rAnselm's@0r @3rSpellbook@0r.
Taking the book, you placed it in the bag
where you kept your valuables.
That was one thing you could stop worrying about.
Now you should return to town, where @7rAnselm@0r was waiting.

translations.en: Huh? What's going on?
You all look so serious. If you keep making faces like that,
you'll bring bad luck on yourselves, you know?
You could only stare blankly as she looked back at you in puzzlement.
Those were the first words @7rFiore@0r
